root_cause: Need-ledger double count in _assign_units_to_objectives pass 1. The OC need of an objective we do not control is enemy_oc - friendly_oc + 1 (and COORD-5's projected need likewise subtracts friendly_oc), so it already counts every friendly model in control range. When a unit already on the objective is assigned HOLD (REMAIN_STATIONARY, it adds no OC), pass 1 subtracted its WHOLE unit OC again (obj_oc_remaining -= cand.unit_oc). At s7454 r3 obj_center was enemy_weak 5 vs 8 (need 4); Custodian Guard Beta had 1 model (OC 3) in range, holding consumed its full OC 9 -> need 0, obj_center read 'already taken by Beta', and pass 2 sent the next units elsewhere: Gamma to flip obj_nml_1 (enemy OC 14) alone, Alpha to obj_home_2. Beta standing still leaves the centre at 5 vs 8, so nobody actually flipped the 20-VP centre.
fix_summary: FIX_LONE_FLIP (const 1.0, get_param): in pass 1, on an objective whose state is not held_safe/held_threatened, a HOLD assignment consumes 0 OC from the need ledger (oc_consumed 0, need unchanged) because the holder is already in friendly_oc. Held objectives keep the old ledger (keeper/surplus-freeing logic untouched). Prints [LONE_FLIP] when it keeps a need open. With 0 the base behaviour is restored exactly. No score term or veto added: the corrected need lets the existing scores pick the centre (Alpha 58.1 -> obj_center), Gamma takes obj_home_2 instead of the lone 14-OC flip.

risks: (1) More units drawn to an enemy-held objective where we have a partial holder: if the enemy's OC there is far above what we can bring, pass 2 may now send a unit to a lost flip it previously skipped (LONE-TRIP / RACE-SKIP still guard fragile units and 3+ turn trips; a durable unit on a 1-2 turn trip is not guarded). (2) A partial holder still HOLDS (stationary) instead of moving its out-of-range models in; the fix does not address that, so the freed need is filled by another unit. (3) In rounds 4-5 units that previously spread to side/home objectives (secondary cards such as Engage on All Fronts, Area Denial) may now converge on contested centre/NML objectives; the trigger is narrow (only enemy-held/contested/uncontrolled objectives with a stationary partial holder) but full-game effect is unmeasured. (4) Held objectives (held_safe/held_threatened) keep the old double count, so a held_threatened objective still frees second holders as before.
